schedules.definitionsHelp: Chore definitions hold the title, description, and clam value. Add schedules below to assign them to users with a recurrence pattern.
schedules.deleteChoreAndSchedules: Delete chore and all its schedules
schedules.addScheduleForChore: Add a schedule for this chore
schedules.schedulesHelp: Schedules link chores to users and specify when they recur. A chore can have multiple schedules for different users or frequencies.
schedules.selectDays: Select which days this chore should appear:
schedules.selectAtLeastOneDay: Select at least one day, or use the "One-time task" toggle above.
schedules.crontabRequired: Enter a crontab expression, or choose a preset.
schedules.appearsOnce: This chore will appear once and hide itself after completion.
schedules.dueDateHelp: Calendar deadline. The chore turns yellow when due, red when overdue.
schedules.daysUntilDueHelp: Leave blank for no due date. This sets a relative due-date offset for recurring chores.
schedules.dueTimeHelp: Time of day this chore is due. Required to play a sound.
schedules.repeatReminderHelp: Leave blank to ring once. Reminders repeat until the chore is completed.
schedules.canSnoozeHelp: Allows the scheduled time to be deferred by a set time.
schedules.deleteScheduleWarning: This will permanently delete this schedule. Completion history is preserved.
schedules.deleteChoreWarning: This will permanently delete the chore and all {{count}} schedule(s) linked to it. Completion history is preserved.
schedules.bulkDeleteWarning: This permanently deletes the selected chores and all of their schedules. Their completion history is kept. This cannot be undone.
schedules.bulkDeleteError: Could not delete the selected chores.
schedules.assignHelp: Pick one or more people, or none for an unassigned bonus chore.
schedules.assignManyHelp: Creates {{count}} schedules, one for each person.
schedules.createdForEach: Created {{count}} schedules, one for each person.

followups.heading: When it's done
followups.help: Follow-ups appear on each person's list when this chore is ticked off. They count toward the daily bonus from the next day.
followups.errorPeople: Follow-up {{n}}: choose at least one person.
followups.errorDelay: Follow-up {{n}}: the delay must be between 1 minute and 7 days.
followups.errorSave: The chore was saved, but its follow-ups could not be.

routines.heading: Routines
routines.intro: A routine is a checklist of steps a child ticks off in the Chores widget, on chosen days or on days with a matching calendar event. Each routine is one chore, so it counts toward the day once. Clams are paid at streak milestones you choose.
routines.noRoutines: No routines yet. Choose New routine to build one.
routines.imported_one: Imported {{count}} routine from the Routines plugin. Its steps are ticked in the Chores widget now.
routines.imported_other: Imported {{count}} routines from the Routines plugin. Their steps are ticked in the Chores widget now.
routines.importedRestored_one: {{count}} routine left in the chore list came back too; give it steps with Edit.
routines.importedRestored_other: {{count}} routines left in the chore list came back too; give them steps with Edit.
routines.name: Name
routines.lead: Due, in minutes before the event starts
routines.leadHelp: All-day events use the start time below instead.
routines.lookahead: Looks 14 days ahead, and keeps up with the calendar on its own.
routines.stepsHelp: In the order they should be done.
routines.noLibrary: Add steps in the Steps tab first.
routines.timeHelp: The start time orders the list; nothing fires at it. The end time decides whether a finish counts as on time.
routines.rewardHelp: Steps never pay out on their own. Set either to 0 for no reward.
routines.editHelp: Changes apply from today. Its history and streak carry on.
routines.deleteWarning: Deleting a routine deletes its chore too. Clams already earned and the completion history stay.
routines.stepsIntro: Build a step once, then use it in any routine.
routines.stepInUse: {{name}} is used in {{routines}}. Take it out of those routines first.
routines.forEach: One routine is made for each of the {{count}} people, each with its own ticks and streak.
routines.bulkDeleteWarning: This deletes the selected routines and their chores. Clams already earned and the completion history stay. This cannot be undone.
routines.bulkDeleteError: Could not delete the selected routines.

expiry.label: Expires
expiry.help: After this, the chore turns red and only a parent can mark it done.
expiry.needsDueTime: Set a due time first: a chore expires after its due time.
expiry.routineHelp: Counted from the end time. After it, the routine turns red and only a parent can mark it done.
expiry.needsEndTime: Set an end time first: a routine expires after its end time.
expiry.needsStartAndEnd: Set a start and an end time first: a routine expires after its end time.
expiry.markExpired: Expired: ask a parent to mark {{name}} done
expiry.dialogBody: Too late for {{name}}. Go get a parent to approve it.

history.untrackedClams: Misses aren't recorded for chores worth clams, so an empty star only means nothing was logged.
history.untrackedOther: Misses aren't recorded for this chore, so an empty star only means nothing was logged.
